item.title: For more than 60 years, visitors walked through a cave in Spain; now 280 motifs identified
item.description: A remarkable archaeological find at Cova de la Font Major has revealed 280 Palaeolithic engravings, showcasing diverse motifs of animals and geometric shapes. This challenges the previously held notion that cave art was scarce in northeastern Iberia, where only two pieces were known. These engravings suggest the existence of unique artistic traditions independent of the famous Franco-Cantabrian region, offering new insights into the cultural practices of Ice Age Europe. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Quantum gas microscope reveals individual atoms in first tunable three-component Hubbard system
item.description: For the first time, an international team of researchers from Germany, Thailand, India, China and the United States has created a three-component Hubbard system with tunable interactions in the laboratory. In doing so, the team used a quantum gas microscope to make the individual atoms visible. The study, published in Science, provides an important foundation for future quantum simulations of nuclear physics and materials science. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: MTG-I2 satellite delivers remarkable first images, capturing a weather view of Europe every 2.5 minutes
item.description: Europe's meteorological satellite agency, EUMETSAT, has released the first image from the Flexible Combined Imager (FCI) on board Meteosat Third Generation Imager 2 (MTG-I2), just over two months after the satellite's launch on Aug. 27, 2026. The satellite will provide forecasters with high-resolution observations of Europe every 2.5 minutes. This unprecedented frequency will help forecasters monitor fast-developing weather hazards more closely and support earlier, more precise warnings. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: Gavin Newsom conmuta la pena de muerte de 548 personas en California
item.description: En una carta emitida el 5 de noviembre, Gavin Newsom, gobernador de California, anunció la conmutación de la pena de muerte de 548 personas por cadena perpetua. Newsom lleva años oponiéndose a la pena capital y, en 2019, decretó una moratoria sobre las ejecuciones en su estado. No obstante, la Constitución de California exige la aprobación de la Corte Suprema estatal para conceder clemencia cuando una persona ha sido condenada por un delito grave en más de una ocasión. La medida de Newsom representaría el mayor acto de clemencia en la historia de Estados Unidos. Publicado también por: BBC News Mundo. Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: Aviones, bancos de sangre, supermercados y medios: una semana bajo ciberataques en Europa
item.description: ¿Qué está pasando en Europa? Los cielos europeos no han tenido tregua. El lunes, varias amenazas de bomba sacudieron una docena de vuelos. La historia se repitió el jueves y también el viernes, llegando hasta más de 35 aviones de 16 países. Dinamarca, Chipre, Rumanía, República Checa, el Reino Unido y Alemania son algunos de los que recibieron llamadas o correos electrónicos de posibles materiales explosivos en sus aeropuertos. También en España hubo cuatro vuelos afectados. Este viernes, a la lista de mensajes amenazantes se han sumado medios de comunicación en Irlanda y en el Reino Unido… Fuente: ABC España - Internacional.

item.title: London councillors reject Berkeley Homes plan after affordable housing offer falls from 40% to 12%
item.description: Southwark Council's planning committee voted unanimously against Berkeley Homes' revised plans for the Bermondsey Place development. The housebuilder proposed reducing affordable housing from 40 percent to just 12 percent, causing strong local opposition. item.title: China keeps a close eye on US midterm shake-up
item.description: The US midterm elections have resulted in the Democratic Party taking control of both chambers of the US Congress, leaving Donald Trump as a lame duck president for the remainder of his term. Professor Steve Tsang of the SOAS China Institute tells FRANCE 24 that, while a weakened Trump could strengthen Beijing's negotiating position, the Chinese leadership is aware that Congress has relatively little sway over foreign policy and is keen to maintain warm personal ties between the two presidents. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: The spring mountain butterfly has been spotted for the first time beneath power lines
item.description: The Universitat Autònoma de Barcelona (UAB) for the first time has detected the presence of the spring mountain butterfly (Erebia epistygne), a species under threat of extinction in Catalonia, under the electricity transmission lines of Red Eléctrica, Spain's transmission system operator. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: Pope Leo embarks on Latin America trip with a first stop in Uruguay
item.description: Pope Leo XIV is kicking off a three-nation tour of Latin America on Friday, November 6, with a visit to Uruguay, the region’s least Catholic and most secular country, three weeks after undergoing lung cancer surgery that had put the entire trip into question. After Uruguay, he will then go to Argentina and Peru. FRANCE 24's Hanna Roberts has more. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: URGENTE - El Senado paraguayo rechaza por amplia mayoría el pedido de prórroga de Santiago Peña
item.description: La Cámara de Senadores de Paraguay rechazó, con 39 votos en contra y dos abstenciones, la solicitud de 72 horas presentada por el presidente Santiago Peña para preparar su defensa en el juicio político. Las abstenciones correspondieron a Celeste Amarilla y Silvio “Beto” Ovelar. Tras la decisión, el proceso continuará en 30 minutos y el mandatario o su equipo jurídico deberán comparecer ante la Cámara Alta. Publicado también por: France 24 - Español. Fuente: France 24 Español.

item.title: Broadcasters Sky, Ireland's RTÉ receive bomb threats, as security alerts sweep Europe
item.description: The bomb threat emailed to RTÉ claimed to be from the same group that has been behind a wave of bomb threats issued to passenger flights around Europe this week, the Irish outlet reported. Fuente: The Jerusalem Post - International.
